HIS MAORI GREETING ... OCT/30th

Instead of shaking hands the Maoris rub noses, and here Flight-Lieutenant Ulm, One of the airmen who made the first flight across the Tasman Sea to New Zealand, receives a greeting from Guide Bella at Rotorus...
THIS MAORI GREETING...OCT 30th

Instead of shaking hands the Maoris rub noses,and here Flight-Lieutenant Ulm,one of the airmen who made the first flight across the Tasman Sea to New Zealand, receives a greeting from Guide Bella at Rotorus.
PRIME MINISTER OF NEW ZEALAND ARRIVES。

Mr G.W. Forbes (centre) Prino Minister of New Zealand, with
Mr J.H. Thomas, who greeted him on his arrival at waterloo
Station last night (Sept. 25th) for the Imperial Conference.

THE DUKE AND DUCHESS OF YORK WITH THE MAORI INDIANS IN NEW ZEALAND.

Their Royal Highnesses the Duke and Duchess of York were extremely delighted with their visit to the Maorewarewa, where they saw the weird wonders of that district coupled with the native dances of the Maori Tribesmen and women.

O.P.S. The Duke and Duchess of York photographed with the well known Maori aide "Bella" in centre of photograph. Behind her is Sir Maori Pomerare, the Minister for Native Affairs. AUC
REGATTA DAY ALONG THE MACRIS..
Cance racing under difficulties. A keen competitor, though nearly submerged, still grips the paddle. An incident of the Maori Regatta, Ngoruawhis, New Zealand.
